definitions.scope: campaigns with 100 or more contestants, plausible dates, finance_crypto organizers and the crypto, ambiguous and purchase-opportunity segments excluded; the 1k keys repeat each cut on 1,000 or more contestants
definitions.source_kind: template: copied from a Gleam library template; own_campaign: copied from an earlier campaign on the same site; campaign_outside_data: copied from a campaign not in the dataset (under 100 contestants or another organizer); blank: built without copying
definitions.template: the Gleam library template name, published because it is Gleam's own; copied campaign names are never published
definitions.conversion: contestants per impression, median across campaigns
definitions.email_offered: share of campaigns with an email subscribe action
definitions.first_campaign: the organizer's first campaign in the dataset by start date (seq 1) against later ones
